anomalies.note: shadow.py was run a second time on the same session file to verify the duplicate gate. Both proposals were correctly rejected as duplicates. The counter self-incremented to 2 and was corrected back to 1 by hand: a re-run of one session file is not a second market session. The two ledger rows from that run are real records and were left in place.

Proposal lifecycle bug found and fixed before session 02. open_proposal_ids accumulated forever, so yesterday's two GFD proposals would have rejected an identical order today as a duplicate. A GFD order dies at the close and a filled one is done; only an unfilled GTC carries forward. State migrated from the ledger. No ledger row was altered.
